scenarios.inputs: Paginated results; stale requests; malformed detail/readme/reviews; custom local and HTTPS list; unknown fields; duplicate IDs; platform/type/console/AI/hide-added filters
expected: No stale overwrite; preserve attribution and cached view; unsupported source has an actionable error

scenarios.inputs: Corrupt/truncated JSON; duplicate identity; legacy and future schemas
expected: Read-only recovery on corruption; preview before migration; no empty-success replacement

scenarios.inputs: 1000 and 10000 synthetic entries with stable IDs and deterministic order
expected: Measure native cold/warm/search/scroll/idle on actual documented device; no generated timings

scenarios.inputs: Missing pin; prerelease/stable; rolling same-tag different digest; ambiguous assets; blocked release
expected: Preserve exact identity; no silent pin fallback or blocked automatic update

scenarios.inputs: Small text-only ZIP with two payload files
expected: Native contained install produces both expected bytes and a complete manifest

scenarios.inputs: Traversal; absolute drive; UNC/device/ADS; backslash; case and Unicode aliases
expected: Reject before writes; no writes outside granted roots; collision policy explicit

scenarios.inputs: Archive symlink target escape; preexisting junction and symlink ancestor definitions
expected: Reject unsafe links; resolve destination ownership before any writes

scenarios.inputs: Truncated central directory and deliberately incorrect CRC
expected: Reject without activating partial payload or deleting old payload

scenarios.inputs: Tiny compressed payload exceeds deliberately low test expansion limit
expected: Fail test budget without allocating an actual archive bomb; file-count and free-space cases remain adapter tests

scenarios.inputs: Supported 7z/RAR/tar paths, hardlinks, special files, reserved names and executable ambiguity
expected: Each supported extractor must independently enforce containment/budgets; unsupported formats fail explicitly

scenarios.inputs: Boundary schedule: download/verify/extract/journal/activate/metadata/cleanup x disk-full/access-denied/cancel/terminate
expected: Restart yields old or new complete manifest; user data unchanged; cleanup never removes active payload

scenarios.inputs: 200/206/416; unknown length; disconnect; 403/429/5xx; expired URL; redirect; ignored Range; changed ETag
expected: Record real byte/stage transitions; restart safely on identity changes; never publish partial payload

scenarios.inputs: Restart at 25/75 percent and after verify; duplicate enqueue; reorder; two transfers; cancel one of two; same-game app/mod commit overlap
expected: Durable jobs; one commit per game; bounded concurrency; cancel does not corrupt another job

scenarios.inputs: Missing/wrong digest; unavailable verification; human review vs scan vs signature; altered/replayed feed; wrong product ID
expected: Mismatch blocks; unknown stays unknown; authentication and digest evidence remain distinct

scenarios.inputs: A to B to C; conflicting B versions; A/B cycle; shared destination; flat/folder-per-mod; selected files
expected: Resolve dependencies/collisions before mutation; failed replacement/removal preserves previous records and unrelated files

scenarios.inputs: Synthetic matching/wrong-region/invalid/truncated files; missing/renamed/locked/link-changed definitions
expected: No Ready for missing/unknown requirement; never modify originals; hashes do not prove legal ownership

scenarios.inputs: Keyboard/controller-only journeys; typing vs navigation; rebind/reset; unplug mid-modal; two controllers; held stick; exit focus; OSK
expected: No focus trap or hidden failure; actual XInput and non-XInput hardware required; URI dispatch is not OSK acceptance

scenarios.inputs: Synthetic secret/path canaries and first-run/decline/opt-in/revoke/offline capture plan
